homonyms.basis: The census row carries no disambiguation field. No card is a homonym: the eight cards concern the knowledge base (its pages, its Query Service, its Wikipedia article, a lesson, three videos). The census separates this row from its field reference row wikidata-pseudonym (P742 alone; census.json field), which is one property of the entity.
distinct_entities: Wikibase, the MediaWiki extension that powers Wikidata (B2)
Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia projects it supplies (B2, B4)
Google's Knowledge Graph and Freebase (B2, B6)
the Wikidata Query Service, a service of the entity (B3)
the census's field reference row wikidata-pseudonym, property P742 (LS-34)
the GND, VIAF, ISNI and ORCID, authority files it links (B6, B10–B12)
the archive's Pessoa Knowledge Graph and Aperture Atlas, projects built on it (#668, #986)

captures.description: THE KNOWLEDGE BASE, SIGNED OUT, 2026-11-01: 'Wikidata is a free, open, and collaborative multilingual knowledge graph hosted by the Wikimedia Foundation. It serves as a central storage hub for structured data used by Wikipedia, Wikimedia sister projects, and external applications.' Key Features: CC0 ('All data is released'); 'Q-number' items ('`Q42` for Douglas Adams') and P-numbers ('`P69` for "educated at"'); statements and triples with references; multilingual labels, descriptions and aliases; the SPARQL Query Service. Eight cards: Wikidata (two), Wikipedia, the Query Service, GitHub, three YouTube videos.
